correctness.rationale: At nominal plume center x=0, three Poisson mean gradients factor information as J^T diag(w_s/mean_s) J. detJ=2Aqd(1−q)/σ², leading to detI=[8w−w0w+/(σ²A(1+β))]t(1−e^−t)²/(1+βe^t)²; AM–GM fixes exposures at E/3. Odd location score is Fisher-orthogonal to even amplitude/background scores with symmetric wings. Its c-objective is t e^−t/(1+βe^t). H_D and H_C are strictly decreasing log-derivatives with opposite signs at endpoints; H_D(1)>0, H_C(.5)>0>H_C(1), yielding unique 1<t_D and .5<t_C<1. Implicit β-monotonicity and asymptotic W(1/(2β)) follow. Independent bisection at β=1 gives t_D=1.273380149669955 and t_C=0.607064681536402. No global optimum over unsymmetric sensor geometry is claimed.
